strings.msgid: Ingest the DAK into the library; it is L2, so it gets no L1 graph. Read Component 1 §1.2 for its sources (extract-dak-l1-references.ts --context-only), fetch each L1 source (fetch-dspace-item.ts for an IRIS handle, fetch-who-publication.ts for a who.int item page) and ingest it. Record on its intake whether each is L1 (declared > context > inferred; --record-context writes §1.2's context). For each L1 source, run l1-specialise.ts: its publication, sections and elements as specialisations of its library nodes, since the library is upstream of L1.
